description: This file defines unit tests and data structures for PKITS (NIST PKI Testing) within the Chromium project, including test info configuration, test execution template, and references to test data files.

classes.name: PkitsTestInfo
classes.description: Holds configuration and expected results for PKITS tests, including policies, test number, and validation flags.

classes.name: PkitsTest
classes.description: Template class for executing PKITS tests with delegate-defined behavior, supporting multiple test scenarios based on test number.

methods.name: SetInitialPolicySet
methods.description: Sets the initial policy set for the test.

methods.name: SetUserConstrainedPolicySet
methods.description: Sets the user-constrained policy set for the test.

methods.name: SetInitialPolicyMappingInhibit
methods.description: Sets the policy mapping inhibit flag.

methods.name: SetInitialInhibitAnyPolicy
methods.description: Sets the inhibit any policy flag.

methods.name: RunTest
methods.description: Executes a PKITS test with specified certificates, CRLs, and test info, adjusting expectations based on test number.
